memory_update.text: Direct public-company exposure to tariff-exemption administration is concentrated in customs brokerage, trade-compliance software, and freight-forwarding platforms.

summary: Tariff-exemption administration is a paperwork-heavy, services-heavy node. The cleanest public exposure sits in customs brokerage, trade-compliance software, and freight-forwarding platforms; large-cap brokers are reference anchors, while smaller logistics groups can be hidden beneficiaries if exemption workload rises.
